Solute Carrier (SLC) Transcript Expression along the Renal Tubule

__________________________________________________________________

This database provides mRNA expression levels for all Solute Carrier Proteins in each of 14 renal tubule segments and glomeruli from mouse kidney (Chen et al. PMID 33769951). Genome wide data can be found at RNA-seq data. Tubule segments: PTS1, S1 proximal tubule; PTS2, S2 proximal tubule; PTS3, S3 proximal tubule; DTL1, type 1 descending thin limb of Henle; DTL2, type 2 descending thin limb; DTL3, type 3 descending thin limb; ATL, ascending thin limb; MTAL, medullary thick ascending limb; CTAL, cortical thick ascending limb; DCT, distal convoluted tubule; CNT, connecting tubule; CCD, cortical collecting duct; OMCD, outer medullary collecting duct; IMCD, inner medullary collecting duct.

Reference: Lewis S et al. SLC-omics of the kidney: Solute transporters along the nephron. Am J Physiol Cell Physiol . 2021 PMID: 34191628.
This website was created by Spencer Lewis and Mark Knepper. Contact us with questions or comments: knep@helix.nih.gov.
